basics.railgunIsASet: RAILGUN is a set of smart contracts on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon and BNB Chain. RAILGUN-compatible wallets provide a private 0zk address. From there you can send, swap, lend and borrow. Zero-knowledge proofs hide who sent what to whom. Non-custodial, private and decentralised: you control your funds.
basics.railgunPublishesItsRelayer: RAILGUN publishes its relayer client, built on Waku, as an open library.
basics.relayersAreRenamedBroadcasters: Relayers are renamed Broadcasters. The client keeps running on Waku.
basics.wakuIsNowLogos: Waku is now Logos Delivery. RAILGUN's traffic runs on its own network of Delivery nodes.
basics.logosDeliveryIsA: Logos Delivery is a peer-to-peer network for private communication. Messages pass between many nodes, so no single machine sees who sent what to whom. Previously called Waku, Delivery is the data transport layer of Logos, the open and modular stack for privacy-preserving applications.
basics.broadcastersPostTheirFees: Broadcasters post their fees. Wallets listen and pick one.
basics.theSealedTransactionReaches: The sealed transaction reaches the chosen Broadcaster. No one else can read it.
basics.theBroadcasterRepliesEncrypted: The Broadcaster replies, encrypted. Only the sender's wallet can open it.

privacy.aRailgunCompatibleWallet: A RAILGUN-compatible wallet uses a 0zk address. A zero-knowledge proof hides the sender, the receiver, the token and the amount. But a 0zk address can't pay gas. A public 0x wallet can, but it is public. Submitting the transaction yourself would reveal your identity.
privacy.railgunHandsYourTransaction: RAILGUN hands your transaction to a Broadcaster, a public wallet that submits the transaction and pays the gas on your behalf. You pay the Broadcaster back privately, in whatever token you hold. On-chain, the transaction appears to come from the Broadcaster.
privacy.publicWalletsSubmitTransactions: Public wallets submit transactions and pay gas.
privacy.announcedOnOpenTopics: Announced on open topics, per chain.
privacy.successOrFailureNotifications: Success or failure notifications are routed back to the sender.
privacy.photoAlt: A person walking alone along a path through tall golden grass in a wide valley
privacy.railgunFirstTriedBuilding: RAILGUN first tried building its networking on libp2p directly, but moved to Logos Delivery to stop IP addresses leaking and putting users' anonymity at risk.
privacy.ifThisCoordinationPassed: If this coordination passed through a server, it would leave a trail to follow and rely on trusting a third party. That is the problem Logos Delivery solves.
privacy.railgunSProofsProtect: RAILGUN's proofs protect the transaction, but not its transmission. Logos Delivery replaces centralised relay servers with secure p2p communication, keeping metadata private.

transaction.howAPrivateTransaction: How a private transaction is sent over Logos Delivery
transaction.allCommunicationBetweenUsers: All communication between users and RAILGUN Broadcasters is sent over Logos Delivery. Five steps, and no server at any point.
transaction.caption0: Broadcasters post signed fee quotes. Wallets listen.
transaction.caption1: The wallet picks a quote on the device. Nothing is sent.
transaction.caption2: The request is sealed for one Broadcaster.
transaction.caption3: Logos Delivery carries it to every Broadcaster. Only one can open it.
transaction.caption4: The result comes back encrypted. Only your wallet opens it.
transaction.eachBroadcasterSignsIts: Each Broadcaster signs its fee schedule with its 0zk viewing key and posts it to the fees topic for its chain. Wallets receive the fees they are configured to listen for and drop any quote that is unsigned, stale or from an unsupported version.
transaction.noOneCanTell: No one can tell which fees you are monitoring.
transaction.theWalletKeepsA: The wallet keeps a local cache of live quotes and picks the best fee for the token it holds. The choice is made on the device. Nothing is sent.
transaction.yourPlanStaysOn: Your plan stays on your device.
transaction.theWalletBuildsThe: The wallet builds the zero-knowledge proof with a fee note for the chosen Broadcaster. It derives a shared key from a one-time private key and the Broadcaster's public key, encrypts the request and hides a random response key inside.
transaction.logosDeliverySLightpush: Logos Delivery's LightPush protocol hands the sealed request to a service node, which relays it across RAILGUN's Delivery network on the transact topic. Every Broadcaster tries to decrypt it, but only the selected one can. It checks the fee and the proof, then signs and submits.
transaction.messageSourceAndDestination: Message source and destination are obscured.
transaction.theBroadcasterEncryptsThe: The Broadcaster encrypts the transaction hash, or the returned error, with the response key and posts it on the response topic. The wallet tries every response, and only its own opens. If none arrives in time, it resends or moves on.
transaction.transactionStatusIsReturned: Transaction status is returned without exposing identity.
transaction.scrollClickAStep: Scroll, click a step or use ←
transaction.receiver: ONLY THIS ONE CAN OPEN IT

stack.railgunSBroadcasterClient: RAILGUN's Broadcaster client is open source, with one package for the browser and one for Node.js. Each RAILGUN-compatible wallet starts a Logos Delivery light node, which does not relay traffic. It uses Delivery service nodes for three tasks: listening, sending and fetching missed messages.

prifi.builtIntoRailgunLogos: Built into RAILGUN, Logos unlocks PriFi.
prifi.toEnablePrivateFinance: To enable Private Finance (PriFi), primitives must be deployed on privacy-preserving, peer-to-peer infrastructure, on hardware you control.
prifi.everyTransactionHasSeven: Every transaction has seven stages, from finding a counterparty to enforcing the deal, and it is only as strong as its weakest link. Secure settlement alone is not enough to ensure privacy.
prifi.railgunUsesLogosDelivery: RAILGUN uses Logos Delivery to make the discovery, negotiation and ordering stages private. Broadcasters are found, fees agreed and transactions handed off peer-to-peer, with no server to log requests and track data.
prifi.railgunUsesLogosDeliveryMobile: RAILGUN uses Logos Delivery to make the discovery, negotiation and ordering stages private.
prifi.railgunSProofsSecure: RAILGUN's proofs secure the payment while Logos Delivery secures coordination.
prifi.discoveryQuotesAndRequests: Discovery, quotes and requests pass peer to peer, with no server in the middle. RAILGUN uses it to find Broadcasters, agree on fees and hand off each transaction.
prifi.discoveryQuotesAndRequestsMobile: Discovery, quotes and requests pass peer to peer, with no server in the middle.
prifi.blendHidesWhereA: Blend hides where a transaction came from before it is ordered. Settlement on Logos is private by default, so no outside contract is needed to hide the payment.
prifi.blendHidesWhereAMobile: Blend hides where a transaction came from before it is ordered. Settlement on Logos is private by default.
prifi.privateEnforcementForTerms: Private enforcement for terms that outlive the payment: escrow, credit and delivery of real goods. The link no settlement layer reaches.
prifi.privateEnforcementForTermsMobile: Private enforcement for terms that outlive the payment: escrow, credit and delivery of real goods.
prifi.logosBuildsPrivacyAcross: Logos builds privacy across the entire lifecycle of a transaction.
prifi.logosDeliveryIsOne: Logos Delivery is one component of the stack, and it is already
prifi.liveInRailgunAnd: live in RAILGUN and other applications.

build.logosIsOpenTo: Logos is open to all builders
build.railgunNeededAWay: RAILGUN needed a way to pass private requests between peers with no server in the middle. Logos Delivery is designed to solve that problem, and it is available to build on now. Use Logos protocols to build your private, peer-to-peer application.
build.railgunNeededAWayMobile: RAILGUN needed a way to pass private requests between peers with no server in the middle. Logos Delivery is designed to solve that problem, and it is available to build on now.
build.shieldTokensAndUse: Shield tokens and use DeFi from a 0zk address in an independent RAILGUN wallet. Pay gas in the token of your choice.
build.logosPackagesTheLogos: Logos packages the Logos Delivery node as one module with an easy-to-use API. Build tools that communicate without intermediaries.
build.logosPackagesTheLogosMobile: Logos packages the Logos Delivery node as one module with an easy-to-use API.
build.runTheLogosStack: Run the Logos stack on your own machine. Basecamp is the launcher for peer-to-peer apps built on Logos.
